text: “Now, look alive in there, will you. Damn that ’ere bag, it warn’t ready night afore last; this won’t do, you know!” “Anything new up in town, Ben?” asked the game-keeper, drawing back to the window-shutters, the better to admire the horses. “No, nothing that I knows on,” replied the man, pulling on his gloves. “Corn’s up a little. I heerd talk of a murder, too, down Spitalfields way, but I don’t reckon much upon it.” “Oh, that’s quite true,” said a gentleman inside, who was looking out of the window.
